llm_judge: `solution.py` iterates indices up to the longest group and appends `group[index]` when available; this takes one item per nonempty group per round while preserving group and within-group order without mutating inputs. `test_solution.py` exercises `round_robin` with ordinary equal and unequal lengths, boundary cases (single and singleton groups, empty groups), fully empty inputs, and checks that input contents and identities remain unchanged and the result is independent.
items.reason: The implementation interleaves by index across groups in their original order, skipping groups too short for the current round. It only reads input groups and appends their elements to a new result. Tests call the public API and cover equal and unequal groups, empty groups and collections, singletons, and input preservation including shared group references.
